verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents its own recurring background automation: sandbox commands can run on a cron schedule, at a future datetime, or after a delay, with execution history per run. Batch jobs can also run on a schedule on serverless infrastructure. This is a true recurring schedule, not a one-off action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, documented event-based triggers, and detail on failure handling or retries for unattended runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Run a command inside a Blaxel sandbox on a recurring cron schedule, a future datetime, or after a delay, with execution history per run.
Run batch processing tasks for AI workflows on Blaxel as scheduled or on-demand jobs that scale automatically and run on serverless infrastructure.
